network: direct: paired plans only; each arm runs in a private worker with *_PROXY cleared and urllib ProxyHandler({}); the batch process also clears *_PROXY
order: plans run sequentially in manifest order (case order of spec, r1 then r2); first arm single in r1, multi in r2

expectations.a1-small-hashlib-blake2: single: lower cost at equal quality
expectations.a2-parallel-read-brain-registry: multi: possibly shorter wall time at similar tokens
expectations.a3-parallel-fix-three-brains: multi: possibly shorter wall time, higher tokens
expectations.a5-dependent-sample-arguments: single: better (steps change the same function in order)

stop_rules: two consecutive plans with provider failure or unknown usage stop the batch
cost_recording: user monitors provider billing; known exact usage and unknown-usage entries are recorded, unknown never counted as zero
b_selection_rule: after A: categories whose multi arm has any agent with provider-reported input peak >= trigger_tokens or tool folds > 0; up to two, highest peak first
claims_limit: one case per category; observations per category, no significance, no general superiority claim
